newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end higher after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end higher after U.S. data.

text.p: 1615 GMT - Austrian bond futures closed at the session high, buoyed by U.S. September NAPM data which was weaker than expected.
Some traders forecast further gains ahead of U.S. payrolls data on Friday.
Turnover remained slim, however, with just 280 lots traded in front month futures.
* Benchmark 10-year 6.25 percent up 10 bps at 100.85 to yield 6.13 (6.15) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 101.02/12 to yield 6.11/10 percent.
* At the near end, five-year 5.25 percent bond maturing March 2001 up five bps at 101.55 to yield 5.12 (5.13) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 101.72/82 to yield 5.08/05 percent.
* 10-year spread to German bunds up one at seven bps, five-year up two at four bps.
* December AGB future up eight bps at 105.00 on volume of 280 contracts.
* Money market rates steady with 3-month VIBOR at 3.342 and overnight money at 3.06/3.31. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
